title: Secrets manifest
description: The secrets of the .env.template next to this manifest and how n8n-starter fills them, into the .env or, for the ones no container reads, into the .env.secrets beside it; the CLI validates the same shape in packages/cli/src/schemas/secrets.ts, see ../SPEC.md

description.description: What the secret protects; the message of the `secrets set` prompt

related.description: Keys of the same template that are no secrets but belong to this one, such as the email of a login; `secrets read` prints them with it

random.description: Random bytes, the generator of an entry that names none

bcrypt.description: The bcrypt hash of another key: a derived value that `setup` and `secrets set` keep in step with its input

input.description: A random generate key of the same manifest, usually one kept in .env.secrets

generate.description: A value `setup` writes: random once while the key is empty or still holds the template value, or derived from another key and kept in step with it

rotation.description: What changing the value later costs: nothing beyond a restart, a manual step in the service (a database password), or the data in .volumes/ (an encryption key)

file.description: The file beside this manifest that holds the value: .env is what compose reads, .env.secrets is for a secret no container reads (a password whose hash goes into .env); such a key is in neither the template nor a compose file

required.description: The root .env values the secret is required under; every listed key must match

prompt.description: A value a human sets with `secrets set`; `verify` fails without it only under the listed root .env values

link.description: A copy of a generate or prompt secret of another directory, kept in sync by `setup` and `secrets set`; with `required` the key is commented out in the template and optional in the compose file, and `verify` misses it only under the listed root .env values

from.description: The directory of the source manifest, relative to this one
